name: DashCore
description: An Android64 performance diagnostics toolkit for Geometry Dash. DashCore measures gameplay update and render costs, inspects scene-graph coverage, validates three object-bounds interpretations with concrete transform samples, measures GPU dispatch/readback costs, and checks a Bismuth-inspired GLES compute visibility mask. Live render culling remains disabled until off-screen classification is proven correct.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (diagnostic only)
experimental-render-culling.description: Inactive in DashCore 0.7.5. Live object hiding remains disabled while parent-transformed, raw-rectangle, and node-local bounds are compared. The setting is retained for compatibility.
